title: European Rule-of-Law Procedures, 2018–2023
grammar: Recap: time frames with során and folyamán
goal: I can describe the European procedures of 2018 to 2023 on the rule of law, with their dates (*határozat, feltételességi eljárás, felfüggeszt*).
I can place an event inside a procedure or a year with *során* and *folyamán*.
I can say how the Hungarian government judged the procedure under Article 7.
